reason: The cited evidence supports that TiC coatings can improve hardness and wear resistance (E1) and that oxidation during deposition reduces hardness (E2), but it provides no evidence for the specific intervention of reactive magnetron sputtering, the use of a diffusion barrier/interlayer, or performance under high-load, elevated temperature conditions.
premises: TiC coatings can increase hardness and wear resistance by 2–4 times compared to the substrate
Deposition temperature significantly affects TiC coating hardness
Oxidation during deposition produces TiO2, which reduces TiC coating hardness
A diffusion barrier/interlayer can mitigate oxidation and improve adhesion
